messages:
sarah-csm: Good morning — Kepler Labs dedicated pool provisioning is live. Need final quota numbers + autoscale settings for tomorrow's smoke and full load test.
ben-sre: thx. Current pool: 4x A100s reserved. Propose soft quota 2000 concurrent requests, hard quota 2400. Autoscale: target CPU 70% -> +1 GPU, cap +2 GPUs. Thoughts?
olga-eng: sounds reasonable. Suggest keeping per-request max tokens at 2k for initial tests to avoid OOM. Enable KV prefix caching for their typical chat prefix (~80% reuse).
kevin-sales: customer committed to steady 350 qps with 2x hourly spikes to 1.2k qps for 5m each during batch windows. We'll confirm exact windows but plan for them.
ben-sre: thanks. For load tests we'll run two phases: steady-state ramp to 350 qps for 30m, spike storm (1.2k qps) x3 5m bursts, and soak 2h at 500 qps. Any objections?
sarah-csm: agree. Ops requirement: no more than 3 rate-limited errors per 10k requests during steady-state. Also need SLO watch set in Console and Slack alerts to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: reserved-pool kepler-2026 provisioned ✅ (pool-id: rp-kk-42). Autoscale group created: asg-kepler-2026.
ben-sre: awesome. Load generator snippets below (vegeta). Replace TARGET with pool ingress endpoint.

```
# vegeta attack -duration=30m -rate=350 -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report
# spike: -rate=1200 -duration=5m
```

olga-eng: for generation tests use a mix of short/long prompts: 70% chat (~150 tokens avg), 30% long-form (~1.6k tokens). That will exercise KV cache + longer seq paths.
sarah-csm: action items — Ben: run smoke tomorrow 09:00 PT, full load Friday 03:00 PT. Olga: prepare warmup script + quantization toggle matrix. Kevin: confirm spike windows with Kepler by EOD.
ben-sre: putting smoke job on my calendar. I'll drop a short runbook in the thread when ready.
ben-sre: btw, if we see persistent queuing >2s for 95p, reduce concurrency per worker to 80% via runtime flag.
kevin-sales: told kepler we'll aim to avoid customer-visible errors. I'll nudge them to provide any internal traffic generator they prefer.
sarah-csm: perfect. tagging @eng-oncall for visibility. :thumbsup:
